title: dev.qory.run.exited
description: The runtime exited. The result of the run and its last event.

state.description: succeeded on exit status 0, failed otherwise, including a signal.

exit_code.description: The exit status, or -1 when the runtime was killed by a signal.

signal.description: The signal that killed the runtime, when one did: SIGKILL, SIGTERM.

reason.description: Why the run ended other than by the runtime's own exit, when it did. timeout: the run's time limit was reached and the session stopped the runtime. gateway_lost: the gateway was lost before the runtime's exit was recorded, because Forager died, and the event is written after the run has ended, by whatever sends the record again; exit_code is then -1, since the record contains no status, and duration_ms runs to the last event recorded. run_closed: the events endpoint answered a signed 410 run_closed, and the session stopped the runtime as at its time limit; the event is recorded in the file sink, and nothing further is sent for the run. Absent when the runtime ended by itself or was stopped from outside Forager. The state is failed with each.
